subject: Claim - rear-ended on the 401
body: Hello, my policy is LM-2048817. On September 12, 2026 I was stopped in traffic on the 401 westbound near Keele when another driver rear-ended me. Nobody was hurt. The other driver's insurance info and the police report number (TPS 26-118823) are attached. The body shop estimate for my bumper is $3,850. Thanks, Daniel

subject: Hail damage to car
body: Policy LM-3301942. Hail storm in Mississauga yesterday (Sept 14) dented the hood and roof of my Civic while it was parked in my driveway. No other vehicle involved. Shop quoted $2,400.

subject: Basement flood
body: Our basement flooded on September 9th after heavy rain - the sump pump failed. Carpet, drywall and a freezer are ruined. Restoration company estimate is $18,700. Policy number LM-1199305. We're staying with family while it dries out.

subject: Réclamation - accident
body: Bonjour, numéro de police LM-4410028. Le 15 septembre 2026, à Laval, un autre véhicule a brûlé un feu rouge et a heurté ma portière. J'ai eu une douleur au cou et je suis allée à l'urgence. La police a fait un rapport. Je n'ai pas encore d'estimation pour la voiture.

subject: URGENT need cash today
body: Policy LM-5500113. My truck was stolen from outside my house last night (Sept 17). I didn't bother calling the police, waste of time. I only bought this policy two weeks ago. The truck was worth $62,000 and I need a cash settlement TODAY, I don't want a replacement. Call me.

subject: Fence damaged
body: Hi, a tree from my neighbour's yard fell on our fence in the wind storm on the 16th. About 20 feet of fence is down. Haven't got a quote yet. Rita

subject: Claim LM-6623471
body:

subject: Slip at my rental property
body: Policy LM-7012255 (rental property, 18 Birch Ave, Hamilton). My tenant slipped on the icy front steps... sorry, I mean the wet front steps, on September 20 and broke her wrist. She says she will be claiming against me. What do I need to do?

subject: windshield
body: LM-8834019 - rock hit my windshield on hwy 400 on 21 Sept, crack across drivers side. glass place says $890

subject: Burglary
body: Policy LM-2290178. We came home from holiday on September 23 to find the back door forced. Laptop, jewellery and two bikes taken - roughly $11,500. Police came the same evening, report #PRP-26-55102. Nobody was home.

subject: Accident next week
body: Policy LM-9001246. I'm reporting that my car was damaged in a collision on October 3, 2026 at Yonge and Eglinton. Other driver fled. Damage is around $7,200. No injuries.

subject: Old water damage
body: Policy LM-3345120. I'm only now reporting water damage from a leaking dishwasher that happened back in early July (July 4 I think). The kitchen floor has buckled. Contractor says $9,300 to replace.
